name: typed-hit-map-and-hover
contract: composer_rect returns composer placement from layout inputs without preparing transcript rows
prepare_metadata computes pointer targets without rendering into a Buffer
hit_at resolves the topmost region using the same rectangles as screen painting
opaque sheet and completion overlays occlude covered underlay targets
completion rows preserve visible suggestion indexes
hover feedback is visible for footer, completion, panel, and tool targets
the main transcript is a non-action target; ToLatest exists only when its visible affordance is painted
transcript grapheme cells map to source bytes and optional selection ranges are styled
tool targets are emitted for derived cockpit tool rows; custom panel content is panel-level only
caret metadata is absent when editor focus is off
no-hover rendering preserves the stable reference output
